description: Land Title Settlement Department - Wewahamanduwa, Matara D/S Division, Matara District - Cad. Map No. 820010
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed declarations of land title determinations for specific parcels of land, including owner names, property details, extents, and encumbrances. The content falls under "PART III - LANDS" and involves land registration, ownership details, and property rights - all characteristics of the Land Gazettes category (Type 4).
